'''Helder Spinoza''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served with the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An experienced firefighter,<ref name="SWI" /> Spinoza represented the Wing Guard in the [[Parliament of Guilds]] and in several Guild tribunals. Spinoza was present with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], and several of his fellow Wing Guardsmen in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] just prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]]. Spinoza, alongside fellow Wing Guardsmen [[Corman Jeihn]], [[Pedar Solardo/Legends|Pedar Solardo]], [[Gir Endac]], [[Bialar Selis]], and [[Razell Tameron]], proceeded to ambush an Imperial unit led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]] while they were transporting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to Vader's shuttle, having been secretly notified by Calrissian via Lobot.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] first "Bespin Security Guard" action figure released in [[1980]] was based on this then-unnamed character,<ref name="SWSourcebooks">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=2014-03-06}}</ref> though the package featured a photo of the character later named [[Pedar Solardo/Legends|Pedar Solardo]].
